tiktok.author: yourrealestatebestie1
tiktok.body:
My yard sign answered a buyer last night while I was asleep. 😴📲 No sign-call service. No dynamic QR fees. No lead forms strangers won’t fill out. I built this automation FREE with apps already on your phone — buyer scans, a text sends itself, my phone replies in seconds with the price, pics, and link… and their number lands in my Messages automatically. This is the future of real estate and most agents have no idea it’s possible. 🤯 The full step-by-step build (screen recording + scripts + the guide) is inside the Marketing Manor — workshop link in my bio 🔑 Let me know what questions you have below 👇 #realtortok #realestateagent #realtormarketing #realestatemarketing #realtortips
At 9:47 last night, a buyer slowed down in front of my listing, scanned my sign, and a text wrote itself. And my phone answered them automatically. Price, photos and the link was sent to them. I was already in bed. No app, no monthly fee. I built it for free on my phone. And the best part? The second they hit send, their number landed in my messages like a curbside concierges

tiktok.author: therealcoritess
tiktok.body:
I connected my C&C account directly to Claude and now it pulls my trending Reels, my Instagram analytics, and my whole content library for me. Here’s exactly how: First - do this on your laptop, not your phone. You can only add new connectors on desktop. Go into Coffee & Contracts settings and copy their MCP server URL. That’s it - one link, that’s all you need. Then open Claude → Settings → Connectors → and paste it in. It’ll ask you to authenticate - sign in with your C&C account and hit authorize. Literally one click. And then it’s done. Back in a chat I can say “pull my trending Reels this week” or “show me my Instagram analytics” and it just… does it. I’m working on an automation to pull from my higgsfield ai photo library, make social posts via my Claude/C&C/Canva connectors then auto post with Blotato. Stay tuned for more details on this or DM me for more info!  No more switching between apps. No more manually tracking what’s performing. Claude does it for me now 🤓 check out the link in my bio for a link directly to C&C😘 Follow along, I’m walking through my whole AI stack for realtors. @Haley | Coffee & Contracts  #ClaudeAI #AIForRealtors #CoffeeAndContracts #RealEstateMarketing #ClaudeForRealtors
Great news! One of my favourite platforms of all time, coffee and contracts, is now connected to Claude. So if you're not familiar, coffee and contracts is a subscription based marketing platform made specifically for Realtors. I've been using the site for since like 2020. It produces the most beautiful templates that you can use to grow your Instagram or social media following. They are ready to use templates, they have reels, they have posts, they have guides, they have training, they have everything. Stock photos all on one platform. The cool thing about its connection to Claude is now we can animate automate some of the things that we have been doing and spending our time going in and changing up the fonts and changing up the spacing, adding our photos. We are going to be able to do all of that in Claude and then auto post it on a schedule. It's gonna be amazing. So if you'd like to know how to do it, I'm going to put in my captions the step by step on how to connect it to Claude. All of these connections are the same, so you're going to be able to see that more and more of how you're connecting all of your things into Claude. Then you'll be able to have it search your Instagram analytics, so it'll be able to pull your performance, find out what's performing well, what you should do, um, what you should post next. It can Pull the weekly drops. Coffee and contracts does come out by the month. They have new fresh content ideas every single month. On what's trending on social media. Which is amazing cause you don't have to do any of that leg work. Then you'll be able to pull your your analytics to be able to find out what's working and stay up to date. All in one place where you're already working. Do you have a link in my bio where you can go directly to the site and you can download it from there? Become a member. It's not expensive. This is stuff that we should be paying for. Because then we are not actually thinking of the ideas. Putting this all together. Automate with Claude. We'll be on our way. Let me know if you have any questions. I'd love to see you guys are making
